title: IPAFFS Service Health
description: Is IPAFFS OK? User journeys, SLO error budgets, integrations and platform for one namespace. Every tile links to the layer 2 dashboard that explains it.

list.name: Pod starts (deploys)
list.expr: max by (pod, image) (kube_pod_created{namespace="$namespace"} * on (namespace, pod) group_left (image) max by (namespace, pod, image) (kube_pod_container_info{namespace="$namespace", container="webapp", pod=~"^.+-[bcdfghjklmnpqrstvwxz2-9]{6,10}-[bcdfghjklmnpqrstvwxz2-9]{5}$"})) * 1000

panels.title: Success rate (no 5xx)

azureLogAnalytics.query:
let j = requests
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where (tostring(customDimensions["k8s.namespace.name"]) == "$namespace" or (isempty(tostring(customDimensions["k8s.namespace.name"])) and "$namespace" in ("tst", "pre", "prd") and cloud_RoleName !contains "."))
| where cloud_RoleName endswith "-frontend"
| where name != "GET /admin/health-check" and name !startswith "GET /public/" and name !contains "/assets/"
| extend role = case(replace_regex(cloud_RoleName, @"^.*[.]", "") == "imports-proxy", "proxy", replace_regex(cloud_RoleName, @"^.*[.]", "") == "permissions", "permissions-service", replace_regex(cloud_RoleName, @"^.*[.]", "") == "file-upload-microservice", "upload-service", replace_regex(cloud_RoleName, @"^.*[.]", "") endswith "-microservice", strcat(replace_string(replace_string(replace_regex(cloud_RoleName, @"^.*[.]", ""), "-microservice", ""), "-", ""), "-service"), replace_regex(cloud_RoleName, @"^.*[.]", "")), path = tostring(split(name, " ")[1])
| extend Journey = case(
    role == "notification-frontend" and path contains "/cloning", "Clone CHED",
    role == "notification-frontend" and path matches regex @"^/protected/notifications/?$", "Search & dashboards",
    role == "decision-frontend" and path matches regex @"^/protected/bip-notifications/?$", "Search & dashboards",
    role == "control-frontend" and path matches regex @"^/protected/ov-notifications/?$", "Search & dashboards",
    role == "notification-frontend", "Create & submit CHED",
    role == "upload-frontend", "Document upload",
    role == "decision-frontend", "Border checks & decision",
    role == "control-frontend", "Control (OV)",
    role == "checks-frontend", "FSA checks",
    role == "bordernotification-frontend", "Border notifications",
    role == "bcpadmin-frontend", "BCP admin",
    "")
| where Journey != ""
| extend bad = toint(resultCode) >= 500
| summarize Requests = count(), Failed = countif(bad), p95 = percentile(duration, 95) by Journey;
datatable(Journey: string, Service: string, Order: int) [
    "Create & submit CHED", "notification-frontend", 0,
    "Clone CHED", "notification-frontend", 1,
    "Search & dashboards", "notification-frontend", 2,
    "Document upload", "upload-frontend", 3,
    "Border checks & decision", "decision-frontend", 4,
    "Control (OV)", "control-frontend", 5,
    "FSA checks", "checks-frontend", 6,
    "Border notifications", "bordernotification-frontend", 7,
    "BCP admin", "bcpadmin-frontend", 8
]
| join kind=leftouter j on Journey
| extend ['Success %'] = iff(Requests > 0, 100.0 * (Requests - Failed) / Requests, real(null)), ['p95 ms'] = round(p95)
| order by Order asc
| project Journey, Service, Requests, ['Success %'], ['p95 ms']
| project Journey, Service, ['Success %']

panels.title: Error budget left this month (99.5% SLO)

azureLogAnalytics.query:
let target = 0.995;
datatable(SLO: string, Service: string, Order: int) [
    "Submit CHED", "notification-frontend", 0,
    "Record decision", "decision-frontend", 1,
    "Upload document", "upload-frontend", 2
]
| join kind=leftouter (
    requests
    | where timestamp >= startofmonth(now())
    | where cloud_RoleName endswith "-frontend"
    | where (tostring(customDimensions["k8s.namespace.name"]) == "$namespace" or (isempty(tostring(customDimensions["k8s.namespace.name"])) and "$namespace" in ("tst", "pre", "prd") and cloud_RoleName !contains "."))
    | extend SLO = case(
        name matches regex @"^POST /protected/notifications/[^/]+/declaration$", "Submit CHED",
        name matches regex @"^POST /protected/bip-notifications/[^/]+/review$", "Record decision",
        name matches regex @"^POST /protected/upload/.+/attach$", "Upload document",
        "")
    | where SLO != ""
    | summarize Requests = count(), Failed = countif(toint(resultCode) >= 500) by SLO
) on SLO
| extend ['Budget left %'] = iff(Requests > 0, round(100.0 * (1 - (todouble(Failed) / Requests) / (1 - target)), 1), real(null)),
    ['Success %'] = iff(Requests > 0, round(100.0 * (Requests - Failed) / Requests, 3), real(null))
| order by Order asc
| project SLO, Service, Requests, Failed, ['Success %'], ['Budget left %']
| project SLO, Service, ['Budget left %']

panels.description: Availability SLO of 99.5% per calendar month for the three key transactions: submit CHED (declaration), record decision (review) and upload document (attach). 100% means no 5xx yet this month; 0% means the month's allowance is used up. Ignores the time picker.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
requests
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where (tostring(customDimensions["k8s.namespace.name"]) == "$namespace" or (isempty(tostring(customDimensions["k8s.namespace.name"])) and "$namespace" in ("tst", "pre", "prd") and cloud_RoleName !contains "."))

panels.title: Partner call failures

azureLogAnalytics.query:
dependencies
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where (tostring(customDimensions["k8s.namespace.name"]) == "$namespace" or (isempty(tostring(customDimensions["k8s.namespace.name"])) and "$namespace" in ("tst", "pre", "prd") and cloud_RoleName !contains "."))
| where type !in ("InProc", "SQL", "redis") and type !has "ServiceBus"
| extend partner = case(
    target contains "dynamics.com" or name contains "/trade-crm-adapter/", "Dynamics CRM",
    name contains "/trade-risk-assessment/" or name contains "/commodity-risk-categorisation-decider/", "Risk engine",
    name contains "/trade-notify/", "Notify (trade-notify)",
    name contains "/trade-delegated-authority/", "Delegated authority",
    name contains "/mdm/", "MDM",
    name contains "/graphql/", "Approved establishments (GraphQL)",
    name contains "/address-lookup", "Address lookup",
    name contains "/trade-imports-cloning/", "Trade imports cloning",
    target matches regex @"^ref(-[a-z]+)?[.]azure[.]defra[.]cloud", "Reference data (RDS)",
    target contains "search.windows.net", "Azure AI Search",
    type == "Azure blob", "Blob storage",
    target contains "antivirus", "Antivirus",
    target contains "login.microsoftonline.com" or target contains "b2clogin.com", "Entra ID / B2C",
    target contains "gateway", "Trade API gateway (other)",
    "")
| where partner != ""
| extend failed = success == false and not(type == "Azure blob" and resultCode == "404")
| summarize ['Fail %'] = round(100.0 * countif(failed) / count(), 2), Calls = count() by Partner = partner
| order by Partner asc
| project Partner, ['Fail %']
